name: East Nanto Outpost
title: East Nanto Outpost
summary: A Sho starter outpost destroyed by Martine (acpedia). In the kit, the same ruined green-lit monument tower model (top z 109.9) stands on a grassy shelf at z 82 in rugged hills rising to z 150-200. A wooden shopkeeper's house with a red roof and lanterns, the Life Stone with two signs and a well are beside it.

site.name: East Nanto Outpost
site.notes: The gazetteer entry for this POI is only a map @tele and the nearest exact teleport (life-stone-near-nanto-ea3d) lands on the Life Stone itself; derived @teleloc on open grass 33 m north-east of the monument tower instead (ground z 80.8, nearest tree 8.7 m). Landblocks west of x 44736 (0xE83C-0xE83F) and north of y 12096 (0xE93F-0xEB3F) are missing from the kit: every camera stays inside x 44800-45150, y 11700-12050.

shots.standingOrder: Hold on the Life Stone and the ruined shopkeeper's house, then whip right onto the green-lit monument tower and hold it against the sky; the lens stays put 45 m south-west of the tower.
shots.notes: Whip pan from a fixed lens 45 m south-west of the outpost: hold on the Life Stone and the shopkeeper's red-roofed house, then whip 32 degrees right in 0.3 s at t 3.15 onto the green-lit monument tower and hold it against the sky. The afternoon sun (0.63) is behind the lens.
